text: I submit this motion to designate an accessible parking space on Mulholland Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the east side of Mulholland Avenue, between a point 21 metres south of Krieger Crescent and a point 5.5 metres further south. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Mulholland Avenue, between a point 21 metres south of Krieger Crescent and a point 5.5 metres further south.
